lines.trans: Take him gently in your arms.
He is coming out on his own now.
Directly onto Andrea's stomach!
Thank you so much for your precious help.
I am completely exhausted now.
I am going to collapse from tiredness.
It is Andrea who is truly exceptional.
She is the one who did everything.
Good night to everyone, thank you.
Mathias, what are you doing?
You can see, I am cleaning.
That is not for you to do.
Yes, Camille, it is for me.
It is truly for me.
Then let me help you now.

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?

examples.text: Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

meanings.note: as a masculine noun: pour le bien de = for the good of
le bras droit = the right arm
être le bras droit de quelqu'un = to be someone's right hand

examples.trans: I will become his right hand.

meanings.note: before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel

examples.text: Tu as complètement perdu la tête!

meanings.note: dans une heure = in an hour

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.
Pourquoi il ne m'appelle pas directement?
examples.trans: Why doesn't he call me directly?

examples.text: Ça va, si je parle doucement.
examples.trans: I'm fine, if I speak softly.

examples.text: Elle est trop vieille pour le rôle.
examples.trans: She's too old for the part.

meanings.note: pour faire quoi? = to do what?
faire du vélo = to ride a bike, to cycle
merci infiniment = thank you so much
before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà
object pronoun before the verb: tu me donnes
with reflexive verbs: je me débrouille
merci beaucoup = thank you very much
ne ... pas: not; ne ... plus: not anymore; ne ... jamais: never

meanings.en: pas du tout: not at all

examples.text: Je suis là pour voir Mathias.

examples.trans: Thank you for your valuable help.

examples.text: Qu'est-ce que tu fais à Paris?
examples.trans: What are you doing in Paris?

meanings.note: starts a question: qu'est-ce que tu fais? = what are you doing?

examples.trans: I'm the one who trained you!

meanings.note: c'est moi qui... = I'm the one who...
before the noun: le seul agent

examples.text: Si tu veux le rôle, tu dois changer.
examples.trans: If you want the part, you have to change.

examples.text: Si Kadropov sort avec une belle femme comme toi, il le dit à tout le monde!
examples.trans: If Kadropov goes out with a beautiful woman like you, he tells everyone!

meanings.note: passé composé with 'être': elle est sortie

meanings.en: sortir avec quelqu'un = to go out with someone, to date

examples.text: Le livre est sur la table.
examples.trans: The book is on the table.

meanings.note: sur la table, sur la route
before the verb; t' before a vowel
used alone, after a preposition, or for emphasis: et toi?, avec toi, toi aussi

examples.text: Ça ne va pas du tout.

meanings.note: oui à tout = yes to everything
plural tous (pronounced 'tous' with s): merci à tous
before a noun: tout le monde = everyone
singular and informal: friends, family, children, colleagues of the same age

examples.text: J'ai encore un peu de ventre.
examples.trans: I still have a bit of a tummy.

meanings.note: avoir mal au ventre = to have a stomach ache
place: à Paris, à mon cours

meanings.en: au = à + le, aux = à + les

examples.text: Il est épuisé après le tournage.
examples.trans: He's worn out after the shoot.
